metric.name: normalized_patch_concentration
metric.interpretation: 0 means all selected support cells remain separate at the frozen 1-km patch merge distance; larger values mean more support cells coalesce into shared patches.

matched_primary_exploratory_contrast.matching: exact region_name × record_count_stratum; one animal and one plant pair required; pair must have >=3 evaluable geometry folds
matched_primary_exploratory_contrast.estimand: animal minus plant pair-mean normalized concentration

concentration_vs_validated_lift.interpretation: No positive association between support concentration and validated held-out recovery lift was evident.

region_descriptive_pattern.caution: descriptive only; unequal eligible-pair counts and no independent region-level replication
region_descriptive_pattern.note: Region-level concentration heterogeneity was substantially larger than the matched animal–plant contrast, motivating no taxonomic concentration paper from this cohort.

conclusion: The apparent animal-greater-than-plant support concentration seen in pooled evaluable folds did not survive the factorial cohort's exact region × record-count matching. E9 is closed as an exploratory null; do not promote a taxonomic concentration macroecology claim from this dataset.
next_action: Prioritize E8 observation-process decomposition of the validated animal-versus-plant recovery-lift difference.
